files.next_module_workstream: Split the remaining summary-projection models/builders and the named dashboard activity/network, summary/history/suggestions/stats responsibilities into dedicated modules.
Split raw payload capture and ownership fixtures by path, blob, schema, and bootstrap behavior.
Split raw payload archive finalization fixtures by quota snapshots, identity, recovery, quarantine, and publication.
Split raw payload cleanup fixtures by reconciliation, orphan scans, writer fences, admission, and dry-run behavior.
Split raw payload compression fixtures by eligibility, path repair, budget ordering, CLI modes, and archive publication.
Split archive HTTP and shutdown fixtures by child processes, readiness, imported OAuth jobs, and runtime sequencing.
Split pool attempt lifecycle fixtures by snapshots, dispatch filtering, broadcasts, phases, and orphan recovery.
Split pool invocation orphan fixtures by running cleanup, phase distinctions, atomic recovery, and routing reservations.
Split deferred pool cleanup fixtures by guard lifecycle, synthetic runtime, pending persistence, and failover.
Split stale pool orphan fixtures by selectors, phase classification, active exclusion, rollback, batching, and owner availability.
Split application configuration and invocation-index fixtures by environment, retention, and query-plan concerns.
Split capture snapshot and replay fixtures by prebuffering, spill files, and partial-body recovery.
Split forward-proxy binding and capture diagnostics by route identity, runtime weight, and response classification.
Split forward-proxy subscription and weight fixtures by refresh, bootstrap probing, and endpoint selection.
Split lightweight test support by configuration, filesystem fixtures, and retention database builders.
Split raw capture overflow and projection fixtures by spool recovery, streaming capture, and terminal projection.
Split raw payload file fixtures by path resolution, compression, streaming writes, and search diagnostics.
Split schema migration and maintenance fixtures by raw codecs, manifest setup, and observability snapshots.
Split invocation query/filter/schema migration fixtures by read-model concern.
Split OAuth route rewrite/timeout fixtures by request preparation, response, and failure paths.
Split parallel work stats/timeseries fixtures by archive fallback, windows, repairs, and concurrency.
Split proxy broadcast/runtime harness fixtures by forward-proxy history, settings, and timeseries.
Split request preparation/handshake fixtures by capture, parser cost, body, and handshake paths.
Split routing failover/retry fixtures by reservation, retry capture, and failure timing.
Split routing failover terminal-reasoning fixtures by capture route, overload, and timeout.
Split startup rebuild/retention fixtures by recovery, archive, hydration, and lifecycle.
Split system status/account roster fixtures by archive, account, and projection helpers.
Split upstream account runtime types, account state, and capability projections.
Split OAuth session callbacks, mailbox transitions, and account mutation helpers.
Split upstream account import normalization, tag sync, and import job orchestration.
Split upstream archive batch fixtures by compatibility, query, usage, and OAuth paths.
Split upstream maintenance scheduler/schema fixtures by account plans, routing, and persistence.
Split upstream prompt-cache binding/route-penalty fixtures by resolver, metadata, and lifecycle.
Split upstream relogin/duplicate usage fixtures by mailbox, identity, and snapshot recovery.
Split upstream sync cooldown/capability fixtures by recovery, classification, and maintenance.
